name: First Light
role: The first Black Star vessel capable of routine scientific expeditions beyond Neptune — the ship that opened the Kuiper Belt Renaissance. Remembered for the instruments it carried, not for any combat record.
name_rationale: "First light" is the astronomer's term for the first observation a new instrument ever makes. Chosen in Kemi's descriptive-English register (as with "The Kuiper Belt Renaissance" and the eight sensor names); coheres with the Black Stars Tower that "hears first" and the observation-first philosophy.
provenance_care_note: Aderin-proposed 2026-06-25, confirmed by Kemi the same day. First named Black Star vessel. "First light" is a real astronomy term; used here as an in-world vessel name it carries no other real-world referent. Additional vessels remain open, not invented.
open_questions: Vessel class, crew, capabilities, and appearance beyond the role above are undefined — not invented.
